title: Kapoor Singh Reorganizes the Growing Khalsa

blocks.text: The Panth continues enforcing discipline even in a quieter interval. Men returning from home acknowledge their absence, seek forgiveness, and hand over what they have brought back so that personal gain does not outweigh collective responsibility.

At the same time the Khalsa is spreading outward. Some Singhs build homes, resume cultivation, open centers of congregation, or return with new companions, so the community grows broader and harder to manage as a single body gathered in one place.

Seeing that change clearly, Kapoor Singh brings the question before the assembly and argues that the Khalsa must reorganize into a few contingents. The proposal is discussed in the presence of leading Singhs and accepted as the next necessary step in shaping the Panth for larger responsibilities.
